album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 7

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on G4 and dwells most on F in Hoseyn. The line peaks at G4 (382.1 Hz) at 0:21.8. It closes on D4, not the tonic (C4 → F4 → G4 → D4 → G4 → D4).
